May 28, 2018 - By Vivian Park
Cobblestone Capital Advisors Llc decreased its stake in Northrop Grumman Corp (NOC) by 42.9% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cobblestone Capital Advisors Llc sold 1,605 shares as the company’s stock rose 14.98% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 2,136 shares of the industrial machinery and components company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $656,000, down from 3,741 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cobblestone Capital Advisors Llc who had been investing in Northrop Grumman Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $57.88 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.26% or $0.88 $331.93. About 1.05 million shares traded. Northrop Grumman Corporation (NYSE:NOC) has risen 48.11% outperformed by 36.56% the S&P500.
